projects.title: Vision-Action Agent for SCORM/Articulate 360
projects.description: Built a multimodal agent that reviews canvas-rendered SCORM/Articulate 360 courses by screenshotting the player, reasoning over the visible UI, and issuing CDP mouse/keyboard actions when DOM agents miss the real click target.

projects.title: Agent Memory and Course Content Pipeline
projects.description: Designed a memory layer that fingerprints slides, stores successful and failed interaction traces, and injects those hints into later runs, plus an LLM pipeline that turns long documents into structured prompt clusters and reviewable course content.

projects.title: APPLY SMART - AI Job Application Agent
projects.description: Built an end-to-end agent that uploads a resume, extracts key details, filters listings, and submits personalized LLM-written applications instead of one-size-fits-all copy.

projects.title: Job Market Data Scraper
projects.description: Automated FlexJobs and Glassdoor collection with Selenium and Playwright, turning noisy listings into structured job data ready for analysis.

projects.title: Bank Customer Churn Prediction
projects.description: Trained a TensorFlow neural net to predict customer churn and shipped a Streamlit app so the model could be used for live inference, not just offline evaluation.

projects.title: Algerian Forest Fires Prediction
projects.description: Cleaned and visualized forest-fire data, trained regression models, and compared them with R-squared and MSE, then saved the trained models with Pickle.

projects.title: Holiday Package Prediction
projects.description: Trained a model to spot customers likely to buy a wellness tourism package, supporting tighter targeting and lower campaign spend.

projects.title: Loan Default Prediction
projects.description: Built preprocessing, visualization, and ML models that estimate loan-default risk from historical lending data.

projects.title: Used Car Price Prediction
projects.description: Predicted used-car prices from vehicle features so sellers could set more competitive listings.
